positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer at Amazon Luna where I worked on delivering cloud gaming. Worked with major partners like Ubisoft, GOG, and EA to ingest and productionalize their games on the Luna platform. Check it out here: https://luna.amazon.com/

positions.title: Product Development Engineer
positions.description:
Project Development Engineer for Baryl, where trip planning is made quick, easy, and personalized.

Designed and built the Baryl Explore MVP and iterated on Beta user feedback.

  - Full stack web development using React and Python on top of AWS backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software engineer intern role at Xccelerate, focusing on frontend web development/design using React, Material-UI, and Next.js

Created frontend components and user stories based on design team's recommendations and Figma designs. Worked on bug fixes, feature implementations, and e2e testing.

Contributed to the development and releases of two Xccelerate products as part of the growing platform, Xccelerate Job Board (https://jobs.xccelerate.co/) and Xccelerate Live (https://live.xccelerate.co/).

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Networked systems research - Modeled Quality of Experience for video streaming and web page loading using machine learning on crowdsourced user "Opinion Score" data.

  - Internship: Project on developing a predictive model for Internet application quality using computer vision

company.name: University of Chicago Department of Computer Science

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Studied anterior-posterior axis determination in the midge Chironomus Riparius in the Schmidt’s-Ott lab (UChicago Organismal Biology & Anatomy Department).

positions.title: Lab Technician
positions.description: Maintained the lab cultures for the Schmidt-Ott lab at UChicago Organismal Biology & Anatomy.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Assisted Dr. Jay Koyner's research in analyzing novel biomarkers indicating kidney disease to improve upon pre-established markers. I was tasked with collecting and processing lab samples for the research.

positions.title: Clerical Assistant
positions.description: Patient/office data management, reimbursement handling, ad hoc projects for the Section of Nephrology.

projects.title: Web Page Loading QoE Experiments
projects.description: Crowdsource web page load opinion score data via Amazon MTurk to improve web loading quality and model Quality of Experience using machine learning.

projects.title: Project Rainbow
projects.description: As a member of UChicago TechTeam, I worked on a mobile app project for the Chicago Cook County Board, with the aim of providing digital access to learning tools and information (videos, documents, etc.) for parents, teachers, and children during the COVID-19 pandemic.

organizations.name: UChicago TechTeam
organizations.description: TechTeam is a UChicago registered student organization (RSO) that creates digital tools to support community organizations and the local government in affecting change.
